info.name: MVMNT Carrier Contacts API
info.description:
The MVMNT API enables you to automate freight brokerage workflows by integrating
directly with our Transportation Management System.

Contact Support:
 Name: MVMNT Support
 Email: support@mvmnt.io

request.description:
Query carrier contacts using flexible filter criteria with AND/OR logic.

By default, only non-deleted carrier contacts are returned (deletedAt: { isNull: true }).
Override this by explicitly setting deletedAt filter criteria.

request.description:
Partially update a carrier contact. Only provided fields will be updated.

- **Omitted fields**: Not modified (current value preserved)
- **Provided fields**: Updated to the new value
- **Null values**: Clear the field (set to null) where applicable

When updating contactInfo, the underlying Contact record is updated.
